English says a half dozen (six), while the current တစ်ဒါဇင်ဝက် has less clear word order. One-and-a-half would normally use တစ်ဒါဇင်ခွဲ; this is an assisted clarity improvement, not a native-certified finding that the old text necessarily means eighteen. ဒါဇင်တစ်ဝက် explicitly expresses half of a dozen without adding an Arabic digit. Only the quantity phrase is reordered; since-last-sunup timing, teasing voice and imminent-attack uncertainty are preserved.

Source uses the lowercase race adjective dwarven. Maintained bare Dwarven=ဒွာ့ဗန်, Dwarven District and dwarven paladins establish the same core; 1703 completion uses dwarven (ဒွာ့ဗန်) for the same identity. Capitalization does not create a new core. Reconcile only the phonetic ဒွာ့ဗင် to ဒွာ့ဗန်; recognizable English dwarven and all source meaning remain. Historical inconsistent compounds are not blanket canonical approval. This remains an assisted pronunciation proposal pending native review.
